closure_claim: C0 range machinery is non-vacuous and practically useful for conservative empty-space exclusion and bounded zero-existence evidence on the frozen Knight field. This is sufficient to authorize C1 regularity research, but not shipping proof authority.

c1_primary_handoff_cohort_d8_m2.definition: NEAR_ZERO cells not eliminated by C0: PROVEN_ZERO_EXISTS or UNKNOWN

cost_audit.interpretation: Per-box cost is approximately constant; runtime is dominated by evaluated-box count.
required_before_full_domain_c1_4: estimate surface-cell population by depth from existing sign-change / MC evidence
combine surface-cell counts with measured near-zero boxes-per-cell and per-box latency
batch/vectorize cell evaluation if projected full traversal is operationally excessive

sampling_uncertainty.claim_boundary: No monotonic near-zero depth trend or breakpoint is claimed from n=32.

numeric_margin_audit.scope: PROVEN_EMPTY states across all recorded depth/micro combinations
numeric_margin_audit.interpretation: Margins are reported as measurements only. Machine epsilon alone is not an end-to-end rounding-error bound, so these numbers do not upgrade research certificates to rigorous certificates.
numeric_margin_audit.backend_binding_requirement: Any future rigorous certificate must bind to the exact numerical function/backend used by extraction. If product evaluation is float32/GPU, the error model must certify that implementation rather than a float64 surrogate.

semantic_correction.c1_role: C1 regularity must take ownership of surface-containing / unresolved cells and may combine strict directional monotonicity with endpoint sign evidence to prove zero existence/uniqueness along the certified direction.
